body:
In Codex, `ask` was failing with `AGENT_SPAWN_ERROR` and getting reported as a down local proxy — even when cc-switch was listening on `127.0.0.1:15721`. Codex's default sandbox sets `network_access=false`, so a localhost probe from inside the sandbox returns connection refused.

The Skill now requires `sandbox_permissions=require_escalated` for `ask`, `submit-brief`, and `review`, and retries once before treating that error as a down endpoint.

Validated with `npx vitest run tests/contracts/skill-package.test.ts tests/e2e/codex-skill-smoke.test.ts` (19 passed).

commits.messageBody:
Codex's default sandbox blocks localhost, so ask was misdiagnosed as a down cc-switch proxy. Tell the Skill to require_escalated and retry once.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
commits.messageHeadline: fix: instruct Codex to escalate network for role-invoking commands

title: fix: instruct Codex to escalate network for role-invoking commands
